source: Level configs of every Spire floor (LootDump F11), Characters.csv, region names.

rules.entry: Only Invokers of the Spire's element can enter it.
rules.keyUse: A Spire Key is only used when you win the floor.
rules.sharedFloors: All six Spires use the same 120 floors below; the enemy element rotates, 20 floors of each element.

spires.name: Fire Spire
spires.description: The Spires bring balance to the elemental spirits of Amara, but they draw the Darkborn like a signal flame. Prove your valor by overcoming the challenges of the Fire Spire, which holds still the burning volcanos of the Thursian Mountains.

spires.name: Water Spire
spires.description: The Spires bring balance to the elemental spirits of Amara, but they draw the Darkborn like a signal fire. Prove your valor by bringing peace to the Water Spire, which maintains the countless rivers, bays, and oceans on which all life relies.

spires.name: Wind Spire
spires.description: The Spires bring balance to the elemental spirits of Amara, but they draw the Darkborn like a signal fire. Prove your valor by mounting the Wind Spire, which aids and protects all travelers, be they sailors on the sea or humble pilgrims on the road.

spires.name: Earth Spire
spires.description: The Spires bring balance to the elemental spirits of Amara, but they draw the Darkborn like a signal fire. Prove your valor by purifying the Earth Spire, which brings life and renewal to the forests of the world.

spires.name: Light Spire
spires.description: The Spires bring balance to the elemental spirits of Amara, but they draw the Darkborn like a signal fire. Prove your valor by returning brightness to the Light Spire, which gives all creatures in Amara the power of illusion – of hopes, of dreams, and of ambitions.

spires.name: Dark Spire
spires.description: The Spires bring balance to the elemental spirits of Amara, but they draw the Darkborn like a signal fire. Prove your valor by calming the shadows of the Dark Spire, which blesses the creatures of Amara with silence, stillness, and the promise of rest when time is up.

unconfirmed: Rules text comes from the game's Spires help popup (5 keys a day per Spire, monthly reset).
enemyStatBoosts (floors 1-10 only) are the percent HP/ATK/DEF changes the floor script applies to enemy spawns; which wave each one applies to is not resolved.

The in-battle tip mentions floor-specific buffs and debuffs; beyond these boosts and the stage's ACC/RES and Tolerance, no per-floor status effects were found in the floor scripts. hasInteractables marks floors with objects in the arena (e.g. the 'Explosive' waves).
Rewards per floor are in stages.json (area Tower).
enemiesWithoutWave: on some floors the spawners are named by role only (DPS / RNG / TNK / Boss), so their wave is not known from the name; role 'Boss' marks the floor's boss.
